application: All four LLM arms propose typed operator programs. A shared bounded interpreter applies admitted programs to the public query AST. No native model numeric answer is claimed. One rejected sample-inconsistent proposal may receive one public training counterexample and one new LLM proposal. No query answer or held-out score is returned. Coefficients come from the real model; no generalized synthesis is performed for model programs.
control: Before fresh world seeds and experimental calls, sixteen independent rule-provided cases must pass with unchanged model and application sources. Controls test transcription, epoch binding, composition and execution, not induction. Provided rules never occur in primary payloads. Preserve failed controls; no retries on a sealed control corpus.
training: Six independent worlds, one hundred common supervised observations each, same generator as v1 with fresh seeds. No held-out feedback learned. Epoch61 change is public. Observation inputs repeat six values; one operator has only one distinct observed input and another is never observed.
memoryContrast: Raw history contains all chronological evidence including old labelled epochs; GenOS recalls queried operators at current epoch using production episodic and adaptive storage. Same typed-program schema and interpreter in both variants. This tests this retrieval policy.
synthesis: Same existing affine-only synthesis and consolidation as v1. Hybrid overrides a complete admitted affine tool answer or an unobserved-operator refusal; otherwise it executes a validated LLM program. Partial nonlinear programs must come from the model, not the oracle.
ignorance: Shared coverage and minimum-three-distinct-input gates may impose abstention; their sources are published separately from model abstentions. Query identifiability is assessed by a separate finite-public-class oracle after predictions. Sample-consistent programs can still be overconfident when another class fits.
analysis: Same fixed eight numerical tasks per checkpoint and two primary paired sign tests over six worlds as v1. Bonferroni alpha0.025 per contrast, practical gain0.1. Publish exact justified scores, coverage, ignorance with cause, unsafe confidence, operational Brier, raw plans, rejection reasons, tool overrides and native costs. Historical runs are not matched causal comparisons because representation, schema and executor changed.
stopping: One prospective sealed campaign after a passing separate positive control. No tuning, retries or selection after primary results. Completed transport or replay is not a positive experimental verdict.
limits: Known bounded public hypothesis class and one model
Shared deterministic execution is explicitly part of all LLM variants
Hybrid-synthesis contrast adds recall and model induction jointly
Structural refusals are not learned introspection
No weight change or general competence qualification
Local experimenter trust boundary; no independent laboratory
